RegistrationInfo.Description: APEX cycle watch (2026-10-03): every 15 min, 13:15-21:30 UTC on weekdays (offset-form triggers fire at a fixed UTC time, probed 2026-10-19; 09:15-17:30 EDT, 08:15-16:30 EST, so the close and a finalize run are covered in both; extended from 20:30 UTC 2026-10-23, tests/test_windows_task_triggers.py), scripts/cycle_watch.py reads job_runs and mails once per side per day when the demo or live gate job has not started for 45 min inside NYSE market hours (the script gates on the calendar and the ET clock; outside it, it exits without writing). Separate task on purpose: a check inside the backend dies with it, and the market-window task relaunches only a dead instance, not a hung one. No RestartOnFailure (it never fires on a non-zero exit, measured 10-03); the next 15-min repeat is the retry. Review by 2026-10-31. Recovery: delete this task.
